component.name: Packrat Backup
component.summary: Simple, encrypted backups for KDE Plasma with OneDrive and Google Drive support

description.p: Packrat Backup is a friendly, Qt-native backup application for the KDE Plasma desktop, in the spirit of Déjà Dup. It wraps the battle-tested restic engine so every backup is deduplicated, incremental and encrypted end to end.

Backups can be stored in a local folder or on OneDrive and Google Drive through rclone. A built-in scheduler runs backups daily or weekly, and a system tray agent keeps an eye on things in the background.

Feature release: change detection warns loudly when a backup shows ransomware-like mass changes (Overview tile, red badge, urgent notification, configurable threshold in Preferences); restore individual files or folders from a snapshot; preview the next backup's size with a dry-run estimate; verified restores prove each backup restorable after it finishes; the History page shows which snapshots were verified. Fixes: Overview progress bar no longer flickers between spinner and percent during backups, rclone repository probing no longer attempts init with an invalid location, weekly catch-up honours schedules missed for longer than 8 days, and settings lists round-trip entries containing commas.

Bug-fix and feature release: new backup history page, retention policy with auto-prune after backups, persistent schedule pause, faster Restore page with snapshot caching, and fixes for the nav page order, spurious saves during Preferences load, the stuck Clean Up button, all-zero retention prune safety, and restic launch error handling.

Bug-fix release: no more Restore page crash while a restic operation runs, restic errors during wizard repository setup are handled gracefully, and the tray icon now shows the Pakkie mascot instead of a blue square.
Initial release: restic backend, rclone cloud storage, first-run wizard, scheduler, restore browser.
